title: HollowScanner
description: HollowScanner is a Minecraft 1.21.4 Bukkit plugin that adds a handheld scanner item to help players detect nearby caves and dungeons underground by providing vibration feedback via sounds and particles.
body:
HollowScanner is a Minecraft 1.21.4 Bukkit plugin that adds a unique handheld scanner item to enhance exploration by detecting nearby caves and dungeons underground. Players can easily find hidden hollow areas using vibration feedback through sounds and particles, making survival and adventure gameplay more immersive and exciting.
